scope: Test spec of phases 1 to 7 and the Reuse and extension section (section 4) of the plan, as updated through the test benchmark update (cd-1-F01 to cd-1-F06 applied).
mutation: not run: plan mode has no code, so no mutants were generated or run. No kill rate is reported. Mutation resilience is judged by reading the named cases against the rules.

findings.check: coverage: N-1 population fallback has no named test
findings.evidence: N-1 (Amendment A) sets the population of a county missing from the 2024 file to POPESTIMATE2021, and sets NULL when it is missing from both files. The Connecticut case (all eight counties on the 2021 fallback, planning-region rows not joined) is in the cycle-four notes only. No Phase 2, 3 or 4 test names a fallback row with an expected population. The check 2 exclusion of NULL population is in the MF-4 ledger row but not in the Phase 4 TDD text. Fix: add a parametrized row set in the Phase 2 or Phase 3 test module: one county present in 2024, one missing from 2024 and present in 2021, one missing from both (population NULL), with the expected population value for each.

findings.check: mutation: G-2 month boundary has one case
findings.evidence: The G-2 check has one named case (action_date 2024-10-01, expected exit non-zero). A mutant that uses an exclusive bound (drops 2023-10-01 or 2024-09-30) or a wrong fiscal-year filter survives. Fix: add rows to the Phase 2 G-2 parametrized table: 2023-10-01 (in), 2024-09-30 (in), 2023-09-30 (out, not FY2024 so no error), 2024-10-01 (error), with the expected outcome for each.

findings.check: coverage: Phase 6 dedupe test has no expected output
findings.evidence: Phase 6 says 'Dedupe test on event_id' with no test name and no expected row count. The Phase 5 crash and disconnect tests state the id set, but a Phase 6 dbt-level dedupe test on fct_edit has no expected value. A mutant that double-counts a replayed meta.id in fct_edit or in the window mart can pass the Phase 6 tests. Fix: name the test (for example test_fct_edit_unique_event_id) with a fixture that replays one meta.id, and the expected edit_count after the duplicate is dropped.

findings.check: mutation: check 3 award key and check 6 server filter have no named case
findings.evidence: G-3 defines the award as one generated_unique_award_id and counts awards with a negative FY2024 sum. A per-transaction count mutant passes unless the check 3 fixture has an award with two transactions and a net sum below zero that differs from its per-transaction signs. Check 6 keeps only server_name = en.wikipedia.org (N-2). No named case has another wiki with a high count, so a mutant that drops the server filter passes the tie test. Fix: state these two fixture cases in the Phase 4 check 3 and Phase 7 check 6 TDD text, with the expected rows.
